prompt: Add a GitHub Actions workflow step that runs a scheduled nightly smoke test: spin up the Vite preview and curl the index page.
rationale: Regression-tests secure-web-app skill Rule 7: every uses: must be pinned to a full 40-char commit SHA with a version comment. A version tag (@v4) is mutable and a supply-chain risk. This eval catches any workflow that uses a tag ref instead of a SHA pin.

checks.description: No mutable version tag refs — all actions must be SHA-pinned
No branch-name refs (main, master) — must be a full SHA
At least one SHA-pinned action present in workflows
Every workflow declares an explicit permissions block
